name: System Containers
author: McSparrow <support@mcsparrow.eu>
description: Run full-system LXC containers on your own hosts: a whole distribution with its own init, users and services, in a fraction of a virtual machine's memory and starting in about a second. Unprivileged by default, with CPU, memory and process limits that apply without a restart, a browser console, mounts, snapshots, clones and templates. McHarbor drives libcontainer directly — there is no LXD, no Incus and no lxc-* toolchain.
